name: Apple Chips
desc: Thinly sliced apples baked low and slow until crispy

source.title: Baked Apple Chips
source.evidence: Method, apple count, lemon juice, 200°F and about 2 hours from this page. The savory salt, pepper and chaat masala seasoning is the site's own; its amounts are judgment.

steps: Preheat oven to 200°F and line baking sheets with parchment.
Core the apples and slice them 1/8 inch thick. Toss with the lemon juice.
Lay the slices on the parchment without overlapping. Bake about 1 hour, flip, and bake about 1 hour more, until the edges curl and the slices feel dry.
Season with the salt, pepper, and chaat masala while warm. They crisp further as they cool.
